name: South Africa
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national, regional (9 provinces) and local (sampled). The geography register holds the country root, three national institutions, 9 provinces, 44 district municipalities, 8 metropolitan municipalities and 205 local municipalities (OCHA COD-AB P-codes, from the Municipal Demarcation Board's 2020 boundaries). The map (213 map units: the 205 local municipalities and 8 metros; districts and provinces drawn as outlines) comes from OCHA HDX cod-ab-zaf under CC BY-IGO 3.0. Started as the home of the Pan-African Parliament delegation's candidates (see data/au).

polls.sample: 1,000 respondents in South Africa (21,000 across 21 countries)
polls.question: Wealthy people paying a higher tax on their wealth, as a means of funding major changes to our economy and lifestyles
polls.commissioned_by: Earth4All and the Global Commons Alliance
